marketSummary: Indian benchmark indices staged an assertive recovery in the prior session as Nifty 50 reclaimed the psychological 25,000 mark (closing at 25,044.65, +0.23%) and Sensex rallied over 600 points from intraday lows to settle at 81,106.65 (+0.13%). Following the Diwali-Balipratipada market holiday on November 10, trading resumes on Wednesday with domestic market participants focused on the heavy final leg of Q2 earnings, softening crude prices, and renewed institutional flows into banking heavyweights.
dailyFocus: Ahead of the Wednesday reopening, swing traders must manage gap risks across earnings movers: Cochin Shipyard faces margin contraction overhang post its Q2 drop, while Tata Power and HAL represent critical scheduled earnings volatility triggers on November 11 and 12. Focus on high relative strength setups re-testing multi-week base pivots across PSU banks and capital goods.

Treasury yield softening easing MTM pressures
Short covering from domestic and foreign institutions

catalysts: Upcoming Q2 prints from key integrated power majors like Tata Power
Record order books across transformer and switchgear manufacturers

Recent DAC clearances exceeding Rs 2 lakh crore

news.headline: Cochin Shipyard Q2 Net Profit Declines 50% to Rs 53.8 Cr on EBITDA Margin Squeeze; Announces Rs 3 Interim Dividend
news.summary: Cochin Shipyard reported a 50% YoY decline in Q2 consolidated net profit to Rs 53.8 crore despite an 11.7% increase in operational revenue to Rs 1,249.2 crore. Consolidated EBITDA margins contracted sharply to 4.1% from 6.6% YoY due to cost pressures in core shipbuilding, even as the ship-repair business posted 30% revenue expansion. The board declared an interim dividend of Rs 3 per share (face value Rs 5) with a record date set for November 16, 2026.
news.impact: Expect gap-down pressure at Wednesday's open; swing setups should watch if price defends the 1,200-1,220 support shelf or breaks down below base structure.

news.headline: Tata Power in Focus Ahead of Q2 FY27 Financial Results on November 11
news.summary: Tata Power Company Ltd is slated to announce its Q2 FY27 earnings on Wednesday, November 11. Brokerages forecast consolidated revenue growth of 26-28% YoY driven by section 11 operations at the Mundra facility, renewable capacity additions, and solid distribution performance across Odisha.
news.impact: A beat on EBITDA margin exceeding 22% can trigger a continuation breakout from its multiday ascending triangle setup.

news.headline: Bharat Electronics Backlog Hits Rs 68,717 Cr as Motilal Oswal Upgrades Target Post-Q2 Beat
news.summary: Bharat Electronics delivered a 19.7% YoY growth in Q2 consolidated net profit to Rs 1,540.4 crore alongside a 26.5% jump in revenue to Rs 7,327.7 crore. Its order backlog reached Rs 68,717 crore as of October 1. Following execution beats, Motilal Oswal reiterated a Buy rating and rolled forward target valuation to Rs 540 per share, citing an impending Rs 20,000 crore next-generation corvette pipeline.
news.impact: Strong volume accumulation post-results makes BEL a primary candidate for high-tight flag breakouts on dips toward short-term moving averages.

news.headline: CG Power Assesses MPCB Waluj Unit Closure Directive Amid 10% Open Interest Spurt
news.summary: CG Power and Industrial Solutions received an operational closure directive from the Maharashtra Pollution Control Board for its MIDC Waluj manufacturing unit under the Water and Air Acts. The company stated it is legally reviewing the directive and verifying financial implications. In derivatives, open interest surged over 10% as the scrip digested the news following its solid Q2 print (profit +44% to Rs 409 cr; order book Rs 23,646 cr).
news.impact: Increased derivatives open interest indicates institutional re-hedging; wait for a clear stabilization bar above the 200-day moving average before attempting swing re-entry.

news.headline: Hindustan Aeronautics Board Scheduled to Meet on November 12 to Consider Q2 Results
news.summary: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd (HAL) has notified the exchanges that its Board of Directors will meet on Thursday, November 12, 2026, to review and approve audited quarterly financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Street attention will focus on aircraft delivery execution rates, order inflow ramp-ups from recent DAC approvals, and manufacturing margin resilience.
news.impact: Stock trades in a sideways compression band; swing participants should avoid anticipatory longs and await earnings reaction above recent consolidation highs.

news.headline: Trent Net Profit Rises 25% YoY to Rs 468 Cr as Zudio Nears 1,000 Stores; Noel Tata Steps Down Nov 11
news.summary: Tata Group retail flagship Trent posted a 25% YoY increase in consolidated net profit to Rs 468 crore with revenue expanding 22% to Rs 5,873 crore for the quarter. The company operates 311 Westside and 999 Zudio stores across 18.5 million sq ft. Noel Tata will retire as Chairman and Director on November 11 in adherence with Tata governance guidelines.
news.impact: Price is attempting to form a multi-week bottoming base following previous corrections; a sustained cross above the 50-DMA on heavy volume will validate the turn.

news.headline: Ashoka Buildcon Secures Letter of Acceptance for Rs 866 Crore Highway Project from NHAI
news.summary: Infrastructure engineering company Ashoka Buildcon received a formal Letter of Acceptance (LoA) from the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) for a road project valued at Rs 866 crore. The fresh inflow bolsters order book visibility within the EPC segment.
news.impact: Direct positive catalyst for small/midcap infra desks; watch for an opening range breakout accompanied by above-average first-hour volume.

news.headline: Jyothy Labs Buyback Committee Increases Tender Buyback Price to Rs 240 Per Share
news.summary: FMCG company Jyothy Labs announced that its buyback committee approved an upward revision in the proposed buyback price from Rs 215 to Rs 240 per equity share to enhance shareholder value and optimize the payout structure.
news.impact: Higher buyback pricing establishes an explicit valuation floor; favorable for low-risk pullback entries toward short-term support levels.

news.headline: MRF Q2 Net Profit Declines 13% to Rs 417 Cr Due to Higher Rubber Costs; Board Declares Rs 3 Dividend
news.summary: Tyre manufacturing leader MRF posted a 13% YoY decline in Q2 net profit to Rs 417 crore, despite top-line revenue rising 17% YoY, as elevated raw material expenses compressed gross margins. The board approved an interim dividend of Rs 3 per share (30% on face value Rs 10) with November 17, 2026, set as the record date.
news.impact: Margin pressure limits breakout potential in auto ancillaries; expect the stock to oscillate within its established broad trading corridor.

news.headline: Nifty Reclaims 25,000 Level on FPI Short Covering and PSU Banking Strength
news.summary: The Nifty 50 snapped intraday weakness to finish Monday's session at 25,044.65 (+58.25 points) led by a sharp 4% rally in the Nifty PSU Bank index. Falling global crude prices and renewed foreign institutional buying in large-cap banking heavyweights spurred a 600-point recovery from lows ahead of the midweek reopening.
news.impact: Broad index breadth is repairing; swing traders can resume sizing up canonical base breakouts in sector leaders that held 20-day moving averages.
